name: proyecto-etl
description: Pipeline ETL y dashboard académico - Universidad Mariana

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix academic-record && npm install --prefix backend-biblioteca && npm install --prefix backend-laboratorios && npm install --prefix core-dwh && npm install --prefix dashboard-dwh
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ACADEMIC,BIBLIOTECA,LABORATORIOS,CORE,DASHBOARD -c cyan,magenta,yellow,blue,green "npm run dev:academic" "npm run dev:biblioteca" "npm run dev:laboratorios" "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:dashboard"
